---
title: "Analysis of the impact of the low-emission zone (LEZ) on contaminants and arrhythmia incidence in the city of Barcelona"
format: html
---

Data is not available due to privacy restrictions. Below is the code used for the analysis of the impact of LEZ on contaminants and arrhythmia incidence time series.

# Analysis of the Impact Low Emission Zone (LEZ)

The LEZ was implanted on 01-01-2020. 

## To arrhythmias

`r tab_nums("counts_zbe", "Number of patients with none, 1 or more arrhythmias previous and after the implementation of the ZBE (01-01-2020)")`

```{r}
case_data |>
  group_by(zbe, patient_id) |>
  summarise(n_auri = sum(y_auri, na.rm = TRUE), n_vent = sum(y_vent)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(across(
    starts_with("n_"),
    ~ case_when(. >= 3 ~ 3, .default = .) |>
      factor(levels = 0:3, labels = c("Cap", "1", "2", "3+"))
  )) |>
  mutate(zbe = factor(zbe, levels = 0:1, labels = c("Pre", "Post"))) |>
  tbl_summary(
    by = zbe,
    include = c(n_auri, n_vent),
    label = c(
      n_auri ~ "Auricular arrhythmias",
      n_vent ~ "Ventricular arrhythmias"
    )
  )
```

`r tab_nums("tab_ar_epi_1_zbe", "Arrhythmias episodes previous and after the implementation of ZBE")`

```{r}
data_fup <- data_clinic |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    fup_date_2 = min(fup_date, ymd("2020-01-01")),
    fecha_inicio_seguimiento_2 = max(
      fecha_inicio_seguimiento,
      ymd("2020-01-01")
    ),
    t_fup_1 = case_when(
      fecha_inicio_seguimiento < ymd("2020-01-01") ~ time_length(
        lubridate::interval(fecha_inicio_seguimiento, fup_date_2),
        "years"
      ),
      .default = 0
    ),
    t_fup_2 = case_when(
      fup_date > ymd("2020-01-01") ~ time_length(
        lubridate::interval(fecha_inicio_seguimiento_2, fup_date),
        "years"
      ),
      .default = 0
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  dplyr::select(patient_id, t_fup_1, t_fup_2)

case_data |>
  left_join(data_fup, by = "patient_id") |>
  group_by(zbe, patient_id) |>
  summarise(
    n_auri = sum(y_auri, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_vent = sum(y_vent),
    t_fup_1 = unique(t_fup_1),
    t_fup_2 = unique(t_fup_2)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    t_fup = case_when(
      zbe == 0 ~ t_fup_1,
      .default = t_fup_2
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(zbe) |>
  summarise(
    n_auri_pac = sum(n_auri > 0),
    n_vent_pac = sum(n_vent > 0),
    n_auri = sum(n_auri),
    n_vent = sum(n_vent),
    t_fup = sum(t_fup)
  ) |>
  mutate(zbe = c("Previous", "After")) |>
  dplyr::select(
    "ZBE" = zbe,
    "Nº patients with any auricular arryhthmia" = n_auri_pac,
    "Nº patients with any ventricular arrhythmia" = n_vent_pac,
    "Nº auricular arryhthmias" = n_auri,
    "Nº ventricular arryhthmias" = n_vent,
    "Patients-year" = t_fup
  ) |>
  gt() |>
  cols_align("center")

```

`r tab_nums("poisson_model_zbe", "Incidence rate ratio (IRR) of the implementation of the ZBE, estimated by a Poisson regression model")`

```{r}
data_fup <- data_clinic |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    fup_date_2 = min(fup_date, ymd("2020-01-01")),
    fecha_inicio_seguimiento_2 = max(
      fecha_inicio_seguimiento,
      ymd("2020-01-01")
    ),
    t_fup_1 = case_when(
      fecha_inicio_seguimiento < ymd("2020-01-01") ~ time_length(
        lubridate::interval(fecha_inicio_seguimiento, fup_date_2),
        "days"
      ) /
        90,
      .default = 0
    ),
    t_fup_2 = case_when(
      fup_date > ymd("2020-01-01") ~ time_length(
        lubridate::interval(fecha_inicio_seguimiento_2, fup_date),
        "days"
      ) /
        90,
      .default = 0
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  dplyr::select(patient_id, t_fup_1, t_fup_2)

#Auricular arrhythmias
data_auri_pre <- case_data |>
  filter(y_auri == 1, date < ymd("2020-01-01")) |>
  count(patient_id) |>
  #Sobre tota la població!! A case data només tenim els casos
  right_join(data_fup, by = "patient_id") |>
  mutate(n = case_when(is.na(n) ~ 0, .default = n)) |>
  dplyr::select(patient_id, n, t_fup = t_fup_1) |>
  #Si el temps de seguiment és zero no participa en el periode analitzat
  filter(t_fup != 0) |>
  mutate(zbe = 0)

data_auri_post <- case_data |>
  filter(y_auri == 1, date >= ymd("2020-01-01")) |>
  count(patient_id) |>
  #Sobre tota la població!! A case data només tenim els casos
  right_join(data_fup, by = "patient_id") |>
  mutate(n = case_when(is.na(n) ~ 0, .default = n)) |>
  dplyr::select(patient_id, n, t_fup = t_fup_2) |>
  #Si el temps de seguiment és zero no participa en el periode analitzat
  filter(t_fup != 0) |>
  mutate(zbe = 1)

data_auri <- rbind(
  data_auri_pre,
  data_auri_post
) |>
  mutate(
    zbe = factor(zbe, levels = 0:1, labels = c("Pre ZBE", "Post ZBE")),
    t_fup = log(t_fup)
  )

mod_auri <- glm(
  n ~ 1 + zbe,
  offset = t_fup,
  data = data_auri,
  family = "poisson"
)


#Ventricular arrhythmias
data_vent_pre <- case_data |>
  filter(y_vent == 1, date < ymd("2020-01-01")) |>
  count(patient_id) |>
  #Sobre tota la població!! A case data només tenim els casos
  right_join(data_fup, by = "patient_id") |>
  mutate(n = case_when(is.na(n) ~ 0, .default = n)) |>
  dplyr::select(patient_id, n, t_fup = t_fup_1) |>
  #Si el temps de seguiment és zero no participa en el periode analitzat
  filter(t_fup != 0) |>
  mutate(
    zbe = 0
  )

data_vent_post <- case_data |>
  filter(y_vent == 1, date >= ymd("2020-01-01")) |>
  count(patient_id) |>
  #Sobre tota la població!! A case data només tenim els casos
  right_join(data_fup, by = "patient_id") |>
  mutate(n = case_when(is.na(n) ~ 0, .default = n)) |>
  dplyr::select(patient_id, n, t_fup = t_fup_2) |>
  #Si el temps de seguiment és zero no participa en el periode analitzat
  filter(t_fup != 0) |>
  mutate(
    zbe = 1
  )

data_vent <- rbind(
  data_vent_pre,
  data_vent_post
) |>
  mutate(
    zbe = factor(zbe, levels = 0:1, labels = c("Pre ZBE", "Post ZBE")),
    t_fup = log(t_fup)
  )

mod_vent <- glm(
  n ~ 1 + zbe,
  offset = t_fup,
  data = data_vent,
  family = "poisson"
)

cbind(
  broom::tidy(mod_auri, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE),
  broom::tidy(mod_vent, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE)
) |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  mutate(across(
    c(starts_with("estimate"), starts_with("conf_")),
    ~ round(., 2)
  )) |>
  mutate(
    text = str_glue("{estimate} [{conf_low} - {conf_high}]"),
    text_2 = str_glue("{estimate_2} [{conf_low_2} - {conf_high_2}]"),
    p_value = case_when(
      p_value < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
      .default = as.character(round(p_value, 3))
    ),
    p_value_2 = case_when(
      p_value_2 < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
      .default = as.character(round(p_value_2, 3))
    )
  ) |>
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") |>
  dplyr::select(text, p_value, text_2, p_value_2) |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::cols_label(
    contains("text") ~ "IRR [CI95%]",
    contains("p_value") ~ "P.Value"
  ) |>
  gt::cols_align("center") |>
  gt::tab_spanner(
    label = "Auricular arrhythmias",
    columns = c(text, p_value)
  ) |>
  gt::tab_spanner(
    label = "Ventricular arrhythmias",
    columns = c(text_2, p_value_2)
  )
```

`r tab_nums("poisson_rates_zbe", "Arrhythmias incidence rate previous and after the implementation of the ZBE (01-01-2020), predicted by the previous poisson regression model")`

```{r}
pred_auri <- ggpredict(mod_auri, c("zbe"), condition = c("t_fup" = log(100)))

t1 <- pred_auri |>
  as.data.frame()

pred_vent <- ggpredict(mod_vent, c("zbe"), condition = c("t_fup" = log(100)))

t2 <- pred_vent |>
  as.data.frame()

cbind(
  t1,
  t2
) |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 2))) |>
  mutate(
    text = str_glue("{predicted} [{conf_low} - {conf_high}]"),
    text_2 = str_glue("{predicted_2} [{conf_low_2} - {conf_high_2}]")
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(x, text, text_2) |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::cols_label(
    x ~ "Period",
    text ~ "Incidence Rate [CI95%]",
    text_2 ~ "Incidence Rate [CI95%]"
  ) |>
  gt::cols_align("center") |>
  gt::tab_spanner(
    label = "Auricular arrhythmias",
    columns = text
  ) |>
  gt::tab_spanner(
    label = "Ventricular arrhythmias",
    columns = text_2
  ) |>
  gt::tab_footnote(
    footnote = "Rate for 100 patient-trimester",
    locations = cells_column_labels(column = starts_with("text"))
  )
```

`r fig_nums("poisson_rates_zbe_fig", "Plot of the arrhythmias incidence rate previous and after the implementation of the ZBE (01-01-2020), predicted by the previous poisson regression model")`

```{r}
p1 <- plot(
```

`r tab_nums("poisson_rates_year", "Arrhythmias incidence rate per year, predicted by a poisson regression model")`

```{r}
ndata_year <- tibble(
  year = 2017:2022
) |>
  mutate(
    range = map(
      year,
      ~ c(ymd(str_glue("{.}-01-01")), ymd(str_glue("{.}-12-31")))
    ),
    data_fup = map(
      range,
      ~ data_clinic |>
        dplyr::select(patient_id, fecha_inicio_seguimiento, fup_date) |>
        mutate(
          t_fup = map2_dbl(fecha_inicio_seguimiento, fup_date, function(x, y) {
            DescTools::Overlap(., c(x, y)) / 90
          })
        ) |>
        dplyr::select(patient_id, t_fup)
    ),
    data_auri = map2(
      year,
      data_fup,
      ~ {
        case_data |>
          filter(y_auri == 1, year(date) == ..1) |>
          count(patient_id) |>
          #Sobre tota la població!! A case data només tenim els casos
          right_join(..2, by = "patient_id") |>
          mutate(n = case_when(is.na(n) ~ 0, .default = n)) |>
          dplyr::select(patient_id, n, t_fup) |>
          #Si el temps de seguiment és zero no participa en el periode analitzat
          filter(t_fup != 0)
      }
    ),
    data_vent = map2(
      year,
      data_fup,
      ~ {
        case_data |>
          filter(y_vent == 1, year(date) == ..1) |>
          count(patient_id) |>
          #Sobre tota la població!! A case data només tenim els casos
          right_join(..2, by = "patient_id") |>
          mutate(n = case_when(is.na(n) ~ 0, .default = n)) |>
          dplyr::select(patient_id, n, t_fup) |>
          #Si el temps de seguiment és zero no participa en el periode analitzat
          filter(t_fup != 0)
      }
    )
  )

data_auri <- ndata_year |>
  unnest(data_auri) |>
  dplyr::select(year, patient_id, n, t_fup) |>
  mutate(t_fup = log(t_fup))

mod_auri <- glm(
  n ~ 1 + factor(year),
  offset = t_fup,
  data = data_auri,
  family = "poisson"
)

pred_auri <- ggpredict(mod_auri, c("year"), condition = c("t_fup" = log(100)))

t1 <- pred_auri |>
  as.data.frame()

data_vent <- ndata_year |>
  unnest(data_vent) |>
  dplyr::select(year, patient_id, n, t_fup) |>
  dplyr::select(year, patient_id, n, t_fup) |>
  mutate(t_fup = log(t_fup))

mod_vent <- glm(
  n ~ 1 + factor(year),
  offset = t_fup,
  data = data_vent,
  family = "poisson"
)

pred_vent <- ggpredict(mod_vent, c("year"), condition = c("t_fup" = log(100)))

t2 <- pred_vent |>
  as.data.frame()

cbind(
  t1,
  t2
) |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  mutate(across(c(predicted, conf_low, conf_high), ~ round(., 2))) |>
  mutate(across(c(predicted_2, conf_low_2, conf_high_2), ~ round(., 2))) |>
  mutate(
    text = str_glue("{predicted} [{conf_low} - {conf_high}]"),
    text_2 = str_glue("{predicted_2} [{conf_low_2} - {conf_high_2}]")
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(x, text, text_2) |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::cols_label(
    x ~ "Period",
    text ~ "Incidence Rate [CI95%]",
    text_2 ~ "Incidence Rate [CI95%]"
  ) |>
  gt::cols_align("center") |>
  gt::tab_spanner(
    label = "Auricular arrhythmias",
    columns = text
  ) |>
  gt::tab_spanner(
    label = "Ventricular arrhythmias",
    columns = text_2
  ) |>
  gt::tab_footnote(
    footnote = "Rate for 100 patients-trimester",
    locations = cells_column_labels(column = starts_with("text"))
  )
```

## To arrhythmias (excluding COVID-19 lockdown period)

As a sensitivity analysis, we will replicate the analysis but excluding the COVID-19 lockdown period: March-May 2020.

`r tab_nums("counts_zbe_ld", "Number of patients with none, 1 or more arrhythmias previous and after the implementation of the ZBE (01-01-2020)")`
```{r}
case_data |>
  filter(date > ymd("2020-05-31") | date < ymd("2020-03-01")) |>
  group_by(zbe, patient_id) |>
  summarise(n_auri = sum(y_auri, na.rm = TRUE), n_vent = sum(y_vent)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(across(
    starts_with("n_"),
    ~ case_when(. >= 3 ~ 3, .default = .) |>
      factor(levels = 0:3, labels = c("Cap", "1", "2", "3+"))
  )) |>
  mutate(zbe = factor(zbe, levels = 0:1, labels = c("Pre", "Post"))) |>
  tbl_summary(
    by = zbe,
    include = c(n_auri, n_vent),
    label = c(
      n_auri ~ "Auricular arrhythmias",
      n_vent ~ "Ventricular arrhythmias"
    )
  )
```

`r tab_nums("tab_ar_epi_1_zbe_ld", "Arrhythmias episodes previous and after the implementation of ZBE")`

```{r}
data_fup <- data_clinic |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    fup_date_2 = min(fup_date, ymd("2020-01-01")),
    fecha_inicio_seguimiento_2 = max(
      fecha_inicio_seguimiento,
      ymd("2020-01-01")
    ),
    t_fup_1 = case_when(
      fecha_inicio_seguimiento < ymd("2020-01-01") ~ time_length(
        lubridate::interval(fecha_inicio_seguimiento, fup_date_2),
        "years"
      ),
      .default = 0
    ),
    # Post-LEZ: subtract lockdown overlap
    t_fup_2 = case_when(
      fup_date > ymd("2020-01-01") ~ time_length(
        lubridate::interval(fecha_inicio_seguimiento_2, fup_date),
        "years"
      ),
      .default = 0
    ),
    # Lockdown overlap: how long was this patient followed during lockdown?
    lockdown_overlap = time_length(
      lubridate::interval(
        max(fecha_inicio_seguimiento_2, ymd("2020-03-01")), # overlap start
        min(fup_date, ymd("2020-06-01")) # overlap end
      ),
      "years"
    ),
    # Only subtract if there is a true overlap (interval would be negative otherwise)
    lockdown_overlap = max(lockdown_overlap, 0),
    t_fup_2 = t_fup_2 - lockdown_overlap
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  dplyr::select(patient_id, t_fup_1, t_fup_2)

case_data |>
  filter(date > ymd("2020-05-31") | date < ymd("2020-03-01")) |>
  left_join(data_fup, by = "patient_id") |>
  group_by(zbe, patient_id) |>
  summarise(
    n_auri = sum(y_auri, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_vent = sum(y_vent),
    t_fup_1 = unique(t_fup_1),
    t_fup_2 = unique(t_fup_2)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    t_fup = case_when(
      zbe == 0 ~ t_fup_1,
      .default = t_fup_2
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(zbe) |>
  summarise(
    n_auri_pac = sum(n_auri > 0),
    n_vent_pac = sum(n_vent > 0),
    n_auri = sum(n_auri),
    n_vent = sum(n_vent),
    t_fup = sum(t_fup)
  ) |>
  mutate(zbe = c("Previous", "After")) |>
  dplyr::select(
    "ZBE" = zbe,
    "Nº patients with any auricular arryhthmia" = n_auri_pac,
    "Nº patients with any ventricular arrhythmia" = n_vent_pac,
    "Nº auricular arryhthmias" = n_auri,
    "Nº ventricular arryhthmias" = n_vent,
    "Patients-year" = t_fup
  ) |>
  gt() |>
  cols_align("center")

```

`r tab_nums("poisson_model_zbe_ld", "Incidence rate ratio (IRR) of the implementation of the ZBE, estimated by a Poisson regression model")`

```{r}
data_fup <- data_clinic |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    fup_date_2 = min(fup_date, ymd("2020-01-01")),
    fecha_inicio_seguimiento_2 = max(
      fecha_inicio_seguimiento,
      ymd("2020-01-01")
    ),
    t_fup_1 = case_when(
      fecha_inicio_seguimiento < ymd("2020-01-01") ~ time_length(
        lubridate::interval(fecha_inicio_seguimiento, fup_date_2),
        "days"
      ) /
        90,
      .default = 0
    ),
    t_fup_2 = case_when(
      fup_date > ymd("2020-01-01") ~ time_length(
        lubridate::interval(fecha_inicio_seguimiento_2, fup_date),
        "days"
      ) /
        90,
      .default = 0
    ),
    lockdown_overlap = time_length(
      lubridate::interval(
        max(fecha_inicio_seguimiento_2, ymd("2020-03-01")),
        min(fup_date, ymd("2020-06-01"))
      ),
      "days"
    ) /
      90,
    lockdown_overlap = max(lockdown_overlap, 0),
    t_fup_2 = t_fup_2 - lockdown_overlap
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  dplyr::select(patient_id, t_fup_1, t_fup_2)

#Auricular arrhythmias
data_auri_pre <- case_data |>
  filter(y_auri == 1, date < ymd("2020-01-01")) |>
  count(patient_id) |>
  #Sobre tota la població!! A case data només tenim els casos
  right_join(data_fup, by = "patient_id") |>
  mutate(n = case_when(is.na(n) ~ 0, .default = n)) |>
  dplyr::select(patient_id, n, t_fup = t_fup_1) |>
  #Si el temps de seguiment és zero no participa en el periode analitzat
  filter(t_fup != 0) |>
  mutate(zbe = 0)

data_auri_post <- case_data |>
  filter(
    y_auri == 1,
    date >= ymd("2020-01-01"),
    date > ymd("2020-05-31") | date < ymd("2020-03-01")
  ) |>
  count(patient_id) |>
  #Sobre tota la població!! A case data només tenim els casos
  right_join(data_fup, by = "patient_id") |>
  mutate(n = case_when(is.na(n) ~ 0, .default = n)) |>
  dplyr::select(patient_id, n, t_fup = t_fup_2) |>
  #Si el temps de seguiment és zero no participa en el periode analitzat
  filter(t_fup != 0) |>
  mutate(zbe = 1)

data_auri <- rbind(
  data_auri_pre,
  data_auri_post
) |>
  mutate(
    zbe = factor(zbe, levels = 0:1, labels = c("Pre ZBE", "Post ZBE")),
    t_fup = log(t_fup)
  )

mod_auri <- glm(
  n ~ 1 + zbe,
  offset = t_fup,
  data = data_auri,
  family = "poisson"
)


#Ventricular arrhythmias
data_vent_pre <- case_data |>
  filter(y_vent == 1, date < ymd("2020-01-01")) |>
  count(patient_id) |>
  #Sobre tota la població!! A case data només tenim els casos
  right_join(data_fup, by = "patient_id") |>
  mutate(n = case_when(is.na(n) ~ 0, .default = n)) |>
  dplyr::select(patient_id, n, t_fup = t_fup_1) |>
  #Si el temps de seguiment és zero no participa en el periode analitzat
  filter(t_fup != 0) |>
  mutate(
    zbe = 0
  )

data_vent_post <- case_data |>
  filter(
    y_vent == 1,
    date >= ymd("2020-01-01"),
    date > ymd("2020-05-31") | date < ymd("2020-03-01")
  ) |>
  count(patient_id) |>
  #Sobre tota la població!! A case data només tenim els casos
  right_join(data_fup, by = "patient_id") |>
  mutate(n = case_when(is.na(n) ~ 0, .default = n)) |>
  dplyr::select(patient_id, n, t_fup = t_fup_2) |>
  #Si el temps de seguiment és zero no participa en el periode analitzat
  filter(t_fup != 0) |>
  mutate(
    zbe = 1
  )

data_vent <- rbind(
  data_vent_pre,
  data_vent_post
) |>
  mutate(
    zbe = factor(zbe, levels = 0:1, labels = c("Pre ZBE", "Post ZBE")),
    t_fup = log(t_fup)
  )

mod_vent <- glm(
  n ~ 1 + zbe,
  offset = t_fup,
  data = data_vent,
  family = "poisson"
)

cbind(
  broom::tidy(mod_auri, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE),
  broom::tidy(mod_vent, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE)
) |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  mutate(across(
    c(starts_with("estimate"), starts_with("conf_")),
    ~ round(., 2)
  )) |>
  mutate(
    text = str_glue("{estimate} [{conf_low} - {conf_high}]"),
    text_2 = str_glue("{estimate_2} [{conf_low_2} - {conf_high_2}]"),
    p_value = case_when(
      p_value < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
      .default = as.character(round(p_value, 3))
    ),
    p_value_2 = case_when(
      p_value_2 < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
      .default = as.character(round(p_value_2, 3))
    )
  ) |>
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") |>
  dplyr::select(text, p_value, text_2, p_value_2) |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::cols_label(
    contains("text") ~ "IRR [CI95%]",
    contains("p_value") ~ "P.Value"
  ) |>
  gt::cols_align("center") |>
  gt::tab_spanner(
    label = "Auricular arrhythmias",
    columns = c(text, p_value)
  ) |>
  gt::tab_spanner(
    label = "Ventricular arrhythmias",
    columns = c(text_2, p_value_2)
  )
```

## To air pollution

We considered the mean of the daily, weekly and monthly values associated with each of the Barcelona postal codes of the patients included in the analysis.

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Daily

```{r}
#| include: false

sdata_cont <- data_cont |>
  dplyr::select(date, co:so2) |>
  group_by(date) |>
  summarise_all(mean) |>
  mutate(
    time = row_number(),
    zbe = case_when(
      date >= ymd("2020-01-01") ~ 1,
      .default = 0
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(zbe) |>
  mutate(
    time_zbe = row_number(),
    time_zbe = case_when(
      zbe == 0 ~ 0,
      .default = time_zbe
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup()

data_zbe <- tibble(cont = sdata_cont |> dplyr::select(co:so2) |> names()) |>
  mutate(
    df = map(
      cont,
      ~ {
        if (. %in% c("co", "so2")) {
          df <- sdata_cont |>
            filter(year(date) > 2018)
        } else {
          df <- sdata_cont
        }
        df[[.]] <- na_interpolation(df[[.]], option = "spline")
        df
      }
    ),
    mod = map2(
      cont,
      df,
      ~ prais::prais_winsten(
        as.formula(str_glue("{..1} ~ time + zbe + time_zbe")),
        index = 'time',
        data = ..2
      )
    ),
    df_pred = map2(
      df,
      mod,
      ~ {
        ..1 |>
          mutate(
            factual_trend = ..2$coefficients[1] +
              ..2$coefficients[2] * time +
              ..2$coefficients[3] * zbe +
              ..2$coefficients[4] * time_zbe,
            factual_trend = case_when(
              date < ymd("2020-01-01") ~ NA,
              .default = factual_trend
            ),
            counter_fact = ..2$coefficients[1] + ..2$coefficients[2] * time
          )
      }
    )
  )
```

`r tab_nums("zbe_test", "Models to assess if there is a structural change in the trend of time series of contaminants previous and after the day of implementation of the LEZ")`

```{r results = 'asis'}
ntaula <- map2(
  data_zbe$mod,
  data_zbe$cont,
  ~ summary(..1)$coefficients |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column() |>
    dplyr::select(
      "Coefficient" = "rowname",
      "Estimate",
      "P-Value" = "Pr(>|t|)"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      Coefficient = case_when(
        Coefficient == "time" ~ "Trend (pre-LEZ)",
        Coefficient == "zbe" ~ "LEZ Intervention",
        Coefficient == "time_zbe" ~ "Trend (post-LEZ)",
        .default = Coefficient
      ),
      Estimate = round(Estimate, 3),
      `P-Value` = case_when(
        `P-Value` < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
        .default = as.character(round(`P-Value`, 3))
      )
    ) |>
    gt(caption = toupper(..2))
)

for (taula in ntaula) {
  print(taula)
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

### Weekly

```{r}
#| include: false

sdata_cont <- data_cont |>

  group_by(date) |>
  summarise_at(
    vars(co:so2),

      case_when(
        !all(is.na(.)) ~ mean(., na.rm = TRUE),
        .default = NA
      )

    time_zbe = row_number(),

    )

        df[[.]] <- na_interpolation(df[[.]], option = "linear")
        df
      }

    mod = map2(
      cont,
      df,
      ~ prais::prais_winsten(

        data = ..2
      )
    ),
    df_pred = map2(
      df,

        ..1 |>
          mutate(

              ..2$coefficients[2] * time +

            ),

          )
      }
    )
  )
```

```{r results = 'asis'}
}
```

`r fig_nums("data_cont_zbe_month", "Time series of the pollution values monthly averaged, with the line indicating the implementation of LEZ and a line for the trend before the implementation and a line after the implementation.")`

```{r fig.width = 10, fig.height = 8}
data_zbe <- data_zbe |>
  mutate(
    plot = map2(
      df_pred,
      cont,
      ~ {
        ggplot(data = ..1, aes(x = date)) +
          geom_line(aes(y = get(..2)), alpha = 0.3) +
          geom_line(
            aes(y = factual_trend),
            linetype = "dashed",
            color = "blue",
            lwd = 0.9
          ) +
          geom_line(
            aes(y = counter_fact),
            linetype = "dashed",
            color = "darkorange",
            lwd = 0.9
          ) +
          geom_vline(
            xintercept = ymd("2020-01-01"),
            color = "red",
            linetype = "dashed"
          ) +
          scale_x_date(
            date_breaks = "1 year",
            date_labels = "%Y",
            name = "Date",
            limits = c(ymd("2017-01-01"), ymd("2022-12-31"))
          ) +
          ylab(toupper(..2)) +
          theme_bw()
      }
    )
  )

do.call(gridExtra::grid.arrange, c(data_zbe$plot, list(ncol = 3)))
```
